name: The Guardian Open Platform
tagline: Search and retrieve Guardian news content, tags, sections, and editions via a documented REST API.
description: The Guardian Open Platform is a public REST API for The Guardian’s journalism archive and live content. Developers can search articles, retrieve full content fields, explore tags and sections, and filter by date, section, and other facets. Access requires a free API key from the developer portal; tiered rate limits apply, and commercial use has separate terms.

auth.details: API key via the api-key query parameter. Free self-serve registration at the developer portal.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Developer tier: up to 1 request/second and 500 requests/day; non-commercial use only.
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial access: custom throttle, quota, and usage-based pricing; request a commercial key.

rate_limits: Developer: 1 call/second and 500 calls/day; Commercial: custom throttle and quota limits.
use_cases: search Guardian articles by keyword and date range
fetch full article content fields for a known path
list sections and tags for navigation or filters
build a news aggregator feed from Guardian content
monitor recent coverage on a topic for research agents
